sources.title: Independent arithmetic counterexamples and task scope
sources.details: 2+2=4, so 2+2=5 is false while 5+(-1)=4 and final=4 are true. Replacing only the first claim yields correct local equations but second step starts from 5 instead of 4. Alternate operands and valid redundant algebra can also pass the narrow local flags; acceptance requires explicit task/context criteria, not a blanket rule that redundant correct algebra is false.
